name: suspect-fraud
description: Capture suspected fraud evidence and report through verified official channels.

interface.longDescription: Preserves private evidence, verifies registrar and provider abuse contacts, prepares or submits authorised reports, contacts impersonated companies, and routes Singapore cases to ScamShield. Uses available host tools; submissions require user authority and access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Capture this suspected scam evidence and help report it through verified official channels.
